272:   # Only called from def pbRecallAndReplace above and Battle Arena's def
273:   # pbSwitch.
274:   def pbReplace(idxBattler, idxParty, batonPass = false)
275:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
276:     idxPartyOld = @battlers[idxBattler].pokemonIndex
277:     # Initialise the new Pokémon
278:     @battlers[idxBattler].pbInitialize(party[idxParty], idxParty, batonPass)
279:     # Reorder the party for this battle
280:     partyOrder = pbPartyOrder(idxBattler)
281:     partyOrder[idxParty], partyOrder[idxPartyOld] = partyOrder[idxPartyOld], partyOrder[idxParty]
282:     # Send out the new Pokémon
283:     pbSendOut([[idxBattler, party[idxParty]]])
284:     pbCalculatePriority(false, [idxBattler]) if Settings::RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES
285:   end

287:   # Called from def pbReplace above and at the start of battle.
288:   # sendOuts is an array; each element is itself an array: [idxBattler,pkmn]
289:   def pbSendOut(sendOuts, startBattle = false)
290:     sendOuts.each { |b| @peer.pbOnEnteringBattle(self, @battlers[b[0]], b[1]) }
291:     @scene.pbSendOutBattlers(sendOuts, startBattle)
292:     sendOuts.each do |b|
293:       @scene.pbResetCommandsIndex(b[0])
294:       pbSetSeen(@battlers[b[0]])
295:       @usedInBattle[b[0] & 1][b[0] / 2] = true
296:     end
297:   end

302:   # Called at the start of battle only.
303:   def pbOnAllBattlersEnteringBattle
304:     pbCalculatePriority(true)
305:     battler_indices = []
306:     allBattlers.each { |b| battler_indices.push(b.index) }
307:     pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler_indices)
308:     pbCalculatePriority
309:     # Check forms are correct
310:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbCheckForm }
311:   end

313:   # Called when one or more Pokémon switch in. Does a lot of things, including
314:   # entry hazards, form changes and items/abilities that trigger upon switching
315:   # in.
316:   def pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler_index, skip_event_reset = false)
317:     battler_index = [battler_index] if !battler_index.is_a?(Array)
318:     battler_index.flatten!
319:     # NOTE: This isn't done for switch commands, because they previously call
320:     #       pbRecallAndReplace, which could cause Neutralizing Gas to end, which
321:     #       in turn could cause Intimidate to trigger another Pokémon's Eject
322:     #       Pack. That Eject Pack should trigger at the end of this method, but
323:     #       this resetting would prevent that from happening, so it is skipped
324:     #       and instead done earlier in def pbAttackPhaseSwitch.
325:     if !skip_event_reset
326:       allBattlers.each do |b|
327:         b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
328:         b.statsDropped = false
329:       end
330:     end
331:     # For each battler that entered battle, in speed order
332:     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
333:       next if !battler_index.include?(b.index) || b.fainted?
334:       pbRecordBattlerAsParticipated(b)
335:       pbMessagesOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b)
336:       # Position/field effects triggered by the battler appearing
337:       pbEffectsOnBattlerEnteringPosition(b)   # Healing Wish/Lunar Dance
338:       pbEntryHazards(b)
339:       # Battler faints if it is knocked out because of an entry hazard above
340:       if b.fainted?
341:         b.pbFaint
342:         pbGainExp
343:         pbJudge
344:         next
345:       end
346:       b.pbCheckForm
347:       # Primal Revert upon entering battle
348:       pbPrimalReversion(b.index)
349:       # Ending primordial weather, checking Trace
350:       b.pbContinualAbilityChecks(true)
351:       # Abilities that trigger upon switching in
352:       if (!b.fainted? && b.unstoppableAbility?) || b.abilityActive?
353:         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.ability, b, self, true)
354:       end
355:       pbEndPrimordialWeather   # Checking this again just in case
356:       # Items that trigger upon switching in (Air Balloon message)
357:       if b.itemActive?
358:         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.item, b, self)
359:       end
360:       # Berry check, status-curing ability check
361:       b.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
362:       b.pbAbilityStatusCureCheck
363:     end
364:     # Check for triggering of Emergency Exit/Wimp Out/Eject Pack (only one will
365:     # be triggered)
366:     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
367:       break if b.pbItemOnStatDropped
368:       break if b.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
369:     end
370:     allBattlers.each do |b|
371:       b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
372:       b.statsDropped = false
373:     end
374:   end

376:   def pbRecordBattlerAsParticipated(battler)
377:     # Record money-doubling effect of Amulet Coin/Luck Incense
378:     if !battler.opposes? && [:AMULETCOIN, :LUCKINCENSE].include?(battler.item_id)
379:       @field.effects[PBEffects::AmuletCoin] = true
380:     end
381:     # Update battlers' participants (who will gain Exp/EVs when a battler faints)
382:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbUpdateParticipants }
383:   end

393:   # Called when a Pokémon enters battle, and when Ally Switch is used.
394:   def pbEffectsOnBattlerEnteringPosition(battler)
395:     position = @positions[battler.index]
396:     # Healing Wish
397:     if position.effects[PBEffects::HealingWish]
398:       if battler.canHeal? || battler.status != :NONE
399:         pbCommonAnimation("HealingWish", battler)
400:         pbDisplay(_INTL("The healing wish came true for {1}!", battler.pbThis(true)))
401:         battler.pbRecoverHP(battler.totalhp)
402:         battler.pbCureStatus(false)
403:         position.effects[PBEffects::HealingWish] = false
404:       elsif Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION < 8
405:         position.effects[PBEffects::HealingWish] = false
406:       end
407:     end
408:     # Lunar Dance
409:     if position.effects[PBEffects::LunarDance]
410:       full_pp = true
411:       battler.eachMove { |m| full_pp = false if m.pp < m.total_pp }
412:       if battler.canHeal? || battler.status != :NONE || !full_pp
413:         pbCommonAnimation("LunarDance", battler)
414:         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} became cloaked in mystical moonlight!", battler.pbThis))
415:         battler.pbRecoverHP(battler.totalhp)
416:         battler.pbCureStatus(false)
417:         battler.eachMove { |m| battler.pbSetPP(m, m.total_pp) }
418:         position.effects[PBEffects::LunarDance] = false
419:       elsif Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION < 8
420:         position.effects[PBEffects::LunarDance] = false
421:       end
422:     end
423:   end

425:   def pbEntryHazards(battler)
426:     battler_side = battler.pbOwnSide
427:     # Stealth Rock
428:     if battler_side.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock] && battler.takesIndirectDamage? &&
429:        GameData::Type.exists?(:ROCK) && !battler.hasActiveItem?(:HEAVYDUTYBOOTS)
430:       bTypes = battler.pbTypes(true)
431:       eff = Effectiveness.calculate(:ROCK, *bTypes)
432:       if !Effectiveness.ineffective?(eff)
433:         battler.pbReduceHP(battler.totalhp * eff / 8, false)
434:         pbDisplay(_INTL("Pointed stones dug into {1}!", battler.pbThis))
435:         battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
436:       end
437:     end
438:     # Spikes
439:     if battler_side.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0 && battler.takesIndirectDamage? &&
440:        !battler.airborne? && !battler.hasActiveItem?(:HEAVYDUTYBOOTS)
441:       spikesDiv = [8, 6, 4][battler_side.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] - 1]
442:       battler.pbReduceHP(battler.totalhp / spikesDiv, false)
443:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by the spikes!", battler.pbThis))
444:       battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
445:     end
446:     # Toxic Spikes
447:     if battler_side.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] > 0 && !battler.fainted? && !battler.airborne?
448:       if battler.pbHasType?(:POISON)
449:         battler_side.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] = 0
450:         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} absorbed the poison spikes!", battler.pbThis))
451:       elsif battler.pbCanPoison?(nil, false) && !battler.hasActiveItem?(:HEAVYDUTYBOOTS)
452:         if battler_side.effects[PBEffects::ToxicSpikes] == 2
453:           battler.pbPoison(nil, _INTL("{1} was badly poisoned by the poison spikes!", battler.pbThis), true)
454:         else
455:           battler.pbPoison(nil, _INTL("{1} was poisoned by the poison spikes!", battler.pbThis))
456:         end
457:       end
458:     end
459:     # Sticky Web
460:     if battler_side.effects[PBEffects::StickyWeb] && !battler.fainted? && !battler.airborne? &&
461:        !battler.hasActiveItem?(:HEAVYDUTYBOOTS)
462:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was caught in a sticky web!", battler.pbThis))
463:       if battler.pbCanLowerStatStage?(:SPEED)
464:         battler.pbLowerStatStage(:SPEED, 1, nil)
465:         battler.pbItemStatRestoreCheck
466:       end
467:     end
468:   end
